description: Agent-neutral Orlix TCTI next-task roadmap. Repo-local workflow data for the orlix-tcti-next-step skill, not an MCP server.

forbidden_scope: Do not enable CONFIG_ORLIX_HOSTED_EXEC_TCTI in product defconfigs before flip gates pass.
Do not edit generated Linux trees under Build/OrlixKernel/src/linux-*-port.
Do not run simulator or physical-device gates.
reducer_requirements: If this gate fails, emit a reducer or concrete stale-reference command before editing runtime code.
gates.commit_message_template: chore(tcti): keep plan and config rails consistent
stop_conditions: Stop if product defconfigs default to TCTI.
Stop if ADR or PLAN stale references contradict the current TCTI ownership model.

forbidden_scope: Do not mark TODO or evidence reports as pass.
Do not make a schema checker that passes without checking pass and fail fixtures.
reducer_requirements: Schema failures must name the failing report or fixture path.
stop_conditions: Stop if status and passed semantics are ambiguous.

forbidden_scope: Do not assume Apple clang can produce the required Linux ELF without recording the probe.
Do not check generated binaries into the source tree unless a separate review approves it.
reducer_requirements: Toolchain failures must record clang, ld.lld, file, readelf or objdump facts.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): record golden elf toolchain proof
stop_conditions: Stop if the local toolchain cannot produce an AArch64 Linux ELF and no TODO report is emitted.

forbidden_scope: Do not allow host x18 or w18 in TCTI product assembly or generated gadgets.
Do not allow MAP_JIT, RWX, generated executable memory, or host-executable guest text.
Do not expose guest software to native iOS APIs.
reducer_requirements: Safety failures must identify the exact source, generated, or object-disassembly path.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): harden app store safety audit
stop_conditions: Stop on any forbidden executable-memory or x18 finding.

forbidden_scope: Do not execute guest instructions for a structural-only gate.
Do not implement Linux runtime semantics.
reducer_requirements: Metadata drift must produce a reducer with the case id and regeneration command.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): validate exit golden elf structure
stop_conditions: Stop if source hash, binary hash, entrypoint, or syscall shape diverges.

forbidden_scope: Do not add production TCTI assembly.
Do not add gadget dispatch.
Do not run simulator or physical-device gates.
Do not emulate Linux VFS, fd tables, processes, signals, scheduler, or real syscall dispatch.
required_validation_commands: rtk proxy make tcti-golden-elf CASE=init_001_exit EXECUTE=switch-debug
reducer_requirements: Unsupported instruction, wrong syscall, or wrong exit failures must emit replayable reducers.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): execute seed elf in switch backend
stop_conditions: Stop if execution depends on exact raw instruction words instead of decoded semantics.

forbidden_scope: Do not execute guest instructions for a structural-only gate.
Do not broaden AArch64 decode beyond the fixture shape.
reducer_requirements: Metadata drift must produce a reducer with the case id and regeneration command.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): add write golden elf fixture
stop_conditions: Stop if message bytes or syscall shape diverge from golden metadata.

forbidden_scope: Do not add production TCTI assembly.
Do not add gadget dispatch.
Do not write to host stdout as a guest side effect.
Do not call Darwin write or emulate Linux VFS/fd tables.
required_validation_commands: rtk proxy make tcti-golden-elf CASE=init_002_write EXECUTE=switch-debug
reducer_requirements: Wrong length, invalid buffer, and unsupported address-instruction failures must emit replayable reducers.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): execute write elf in switch backend
stop_conditions: Stop if write capture calls host write or implements fd-table behavior.

forbidden_scope: Do not add production TCTI assembly.
Do not add gadget dispatch.
Do not run simulator or physical-device gates.
Do not implement Linux runtime semantics.
Do not generalize the memory model beyond the exact no-phone fixture needs.
required_validation_commands: rtk proxy make tcti-golden-elf CASE=init_001_exit EXECUTE=switch-debug
rtk proxy make tcti-golden-elf CASE=init_003_stack EXECUTE=switch-debug
rtk test env PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" make -f OrlixKernel/Makefile kunit PROFILE=development
rtk test env PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" make -f OrlixKernel/Makefile kunit PROFILE=release
reducer_requirements: Every unsupported instruction or guest-memory fault must produce a reducer before production changes.
At least one new stack-specific reducer must replay through make tcti-repro.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): execute stack elf in switch backend
stop_conditions: Stop if the implementation would require production assembly or gadget dispatch.
Stop if the failure is not reduced into a no-phone fixture first.
Stop if the selected scope tries to implement package, shell, dynamic-loader, or physical-device behavior.

forbidden_scope: Do not mutate host TPIDR_EL0 for guest TPIDR_EL0.
Do not add production assembly or gadget dispatch.
Do not run simulator or physical-device gates.
required_validation_commands: rtk proxy make tcti-golden-elf CASE=init_004_tls EXECUTE=switch-debug
reducer_requirements: Guest TLS failures must prove host TPIDR_EL0 did not change.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): execute tls elf in switch backend
stop_conditions: Stop if guest TLS state touches host TLS.

forbidden_scope: Do not implement gadget dispatch in this diff-preparation gate.
Do not duplicate instruction semantics between switch-debug and future gadgets.
reducer_requirements: Diff failures must identify the divergent architectural state field.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): add switch differential gate for exit elf
stop_conditions: Stop if switch-debug oracle coverage is missing for the target case.

forbidden_scope: Do not use host x18 or w18.
Do not create generated executable memory, RWX mappings, MAP_JIT, or host-executable guest text.
Do not broaden beyond init_001_exit before switch-vs-gadget diff passes.
reducer_requirements: Any gadget mismatch must reduce to a switch-vs-gadget diff fixture.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): diff first exit gadget against switch backend
stop_conditions: Stop if appstore-safety-audit cannot scan generated and object disassembly.
Stop if switch-debug oracle coverage is incomplete.

forbidden_scope: Do not run physical-device gates while no-phone gates are incomplete.
Do not use emergency override to produce a passing gate.
Do not patch from phone logs without reducing into a no-phone fixture.
required_validation_commands: rtk proxy make runtime-validation DESTINATION=iphoneos GATE=tcti-init-first-syscall
reducer_requirements: Any device failure must be reduced to host/oracle/golden test before production patching.
gates.commit_message_template: test(tcti): certify first physical syscall gate
stop_conditions: Stop if any autonomous no-phone report is missing, todo, evidence, or fail.
Stop if emergency override is used and a pass is claimed.
